verdict.rationale: Summer Engine is an AI-driven game engine with agent and MCP tooling, so versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never shows any of these capabilities. The `--dry-run`/`--print` flags only preview MCP setup configuration, and `--channel next` selects a pre-release build. Both are adjacent controls, not automation version history or rollback.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
